newsitem.title: USA: Sonoco sees record earnings in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Sonoco sees record earnings in 1997.

text.p: Sonoco Products Co said Wednesday that it expects earnings to improve in the second half of the year, resulting in another record year in line with objectives.
Sonoco reported fully diluted earnings of $0.47 a share, compared to $0.47 a share the previous second quarter.

"We are experiencing volume gains in most of our businesses around the world, though increased materials costs and selling-price pressures have impacted some sales and earnings results," said Charles Coker, chief executive officer, in a press release.

The company said it continued to have strong performance from its integrated global tube and core businesses, which experienced their strongest volume in the history of the company during the second quarter.
Sonoco also continued strong performance in the global composite can operations during the second quarter.

"The earnings comparisons for the first half of this year were extremely difficult...Going forward, we expect to see our second half performance improve toward our traditional growth objectives, resulting in another record year for Sonoco," Coker said.
